blocks.text: Interior design for apartments and houses in Warsaw

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN worked in Warsaw before relocating to Bratislava, and we still have trusted partners in Poland: renovation crews, a furniture production facility, and installers. That is why we continue to deliver turnkey interiors for clients in Warsaw: the studio develops the project, and the implementation is carried out by local teams we have worked with on our own projects.

Our completed projects in Poland include a 43 m² apartment in Warsaw, 63 m² and 64 m² apartments in Kraków, and an office in Poznań. We develop projects in Russian, Ukrainian, or English; documentation for Polish contractors is prepared with dimensions and specifications that are clear without translation.

items: Interior design project for an apartment or house — layout, concept, and the selection of materials and furniture.

items: Consultation. Online or by phone, free of charge. You send us a floor plan, photos, and your wishes.
Site measurement. Taken by our partner in Warsaw or by you, following our instructions.
Project. Layout, concept, 3D visualizations, and drawings. Revisions are agreed remotely.
Implementation. Renovation and furniture — by local teams we have been working with for years. The studio checks that the work matches the project.
Handover. Final installation of the furniture, lighting, and decor according to the project.

parts.html: Design project prices are the same in every city where we work: the “Express” package — €20/m², “Basic” and “Furniture” — €35–45/m², “Premium” — €50/m², “Premium+” — €70/m². The first consultation is free.

blocks.text: Questions about interior design in Warsaw

items.q: Do you work in Warsaw if the studio is in Bratislava?
items.a: Yes. We develop the project remotely — this is a standard format for design studios. Measurements, renovation, furniture production, and installation are handled by our partners in Warsaw, whom we know from our own projects.

items.q: Who is responsible for the result?
items.a: The DUMSKAYA DESIGN studio is responsible for the project and for making sure the implementation matches it. The work is carried out by crews we have completed projects with before; we check the key stages through photo reports and site visits.

items.q: How much does an interior design project cost in Warsaw?
items.a: The same as in Bratislava and Vienna: from €20/m² for “Express” to €70/m² for “Premium+”. The cost of the renovation and furniture is calculated in a cost estimate in Polish złoty.

items.q: Can I order just the project and do the renovation myself?
items.a: Yes. You will receive visualizations and a set of drawings that any contractor in Poland can work from.

items.q: Do you work in other cities in Poland?
items.a: Yes — we have completed projects in Kraków and Poznań. We confirm whether implementation with our partners is possible for each city individually.
